# Feral Combat Druid — Raid (group)

[Druid](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Feral Combat

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best druid spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Feral Combat — Raid](../research/raid/builds/feral-combat-open-raid.md)** (9/32/10) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/druid/60/050022-52000332123012025001-055-12)

> 🔬 Derived build: found by this project's open talent search (every legal build, no tree rule, in the community's raid simulator in a full raid, raced against the rotation's builds); it beat the hand-made build (Feral — Cat DPS), which stays below as the alternative. A model of the beta, to check at launch.

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Prowl**, **Dash**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Ravage** when Prowl is active
2. **Ferocious Bite** (timing: see below)
3. **Shifting Power** (timing: see below)
4. **Shred** when Cat Form is active and Clearcasting is active (timing: see below)
5. **Rip** when Cat Form is active (timing: see below)
6. **Rake** when Cat Form is active (timing: see below)
7. **Shred** when Cat Form is active (timing: see below)

Between these, your white swings do the rest.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

A raid cat opens from **Prowl** with **Ravage**, keeps **Rip** and **Rake** bleeding on the boss, turns mana into energy with **Shifting Power**, fills with **Shred** from behind and spends high energy on **Ferocious Bite**. This is the official simulator's own Feral rotation (again since 2026-11-20, when it beat ours by 0.8% on this build); the conditions it names (the lines marked "timing: see below") are explained here. In a 3-minute raid fight: **Shred** 47 casts, **Shifting Power** 22, **Rake** 19, **Rip** 14, **Ferocious Bite** 3; **Rip** 25% of the damage, **Shred** 24%, white swings 23%, **Rake** 16%.

**Why it works**

- The opener: **Prowl** before the pull and **Dash** to close in, then **Ravage** while still prowling, from behind: 435% weapon damage plus 98 and a combo point. The rotation drops **Prowl** instead when the approach is too long for the opener to land.
- **Rip** ("Rip due"): put it back up as soon as it falls off. With this build's 2 points in **Blood Frenzy** and **Shifting Power** that is at 5 combo points, or at 4 when one more **Shred** would not leave the energy for **Rip** on the next global cooldown, and not with under 8 seconds of the fight left. **Rend and Tear** adds 15% to your melee abilities on a bleeding target.
- **Rake** ("Rake due"): keep it on the boss unless it dies within 6 seconds: 76 damage plus 126 over 9 seconds and a combo point, and with **Rip** it keeps the boss bleeding for **Rend and Tear**.
- **Ferocious Bite**: **Predatory Discipline** makes it stop using up your extra energy while still hitting harder for it, so it is your high-energy dump. "Midfight Bite is worthwhile": 4 or more combo points, **Rip** with at least 3 seconds left, and 75 energy (45 with a Clearcasting proc; 70 and 40 at 5 points). "Pool energy for Bite": when the points and **Rip** are there but the energy is not, hold **Shred** and let it build. "Fight-end Bite is worthwhile": at 5 points in the last 8 seconds, where a new **Rip** would not tick out; "Final-global Bite": in the very last second, with 2 or more points.
- **Shifting Power** ("Shifting Power ready"): 55% of your base mana for 40 energy, in **Cat Form** at 50 energy or less (with this build's 2 points in **Blood Frenzy**) so none of it spills over your 100 cap; about 22 casts a fight, so mana is the cat's limit (see the caveats).
- **Shred** goes first whenever a Clearcasting proc makes it free, unless you are pooling for a Bite, and is otherwise the filler from behind ("Paid builder fits the energy pool": at 60 energy or more, or under 3 combo points): 1 combo point, 2 on a critical strike with **Blood Frenzy**.
- No powershifting any more: the list stays in **Cat Form**. Forever's **Furor** gives back the energy you left with instead of a flat 40, which does not pay for the global cooldowns of shifting out and back.

**Caveats**

- **Shred** and **Ravage** only work from behind. When the boss faces you, the rotation builds with **Claw** instead ("Claw can replace Shred").
- Mana: **Shifting Power** spends more than half your base mana, so the list leans on a raid's mana buffs, a mana potion and **Innervate** on yourself below 1,400 mana with the fight still going. Without Blessing of Wisdom or Mana Spring (a dungeon group, or alone) you run dry fast; solo, the fight lab found that drinking the mana back costs more time than the energy saves.
- The bear, under Tanking, plays the simulator's own tank list in **Dire Bear Form** on the simulator's own build: **Primal Bite** whenever it is ready; **Lacerate** on every other global cooldown, built to five stacks and refreshed before the five-stack bleed runs out; **Maul** queued with the rage left over, keeping enough for the next **Primal Bite**; **Faerie Fire** and **Demoralizing Roar** kept up when the raid does not supply them. **Lacerate** and **Primal Bite** carry most of the threat (39% and 20% of it in the simulator, **Maul** 30%): a bear without their talents can only queue **Maul**.
- The rotation casts **Ferocious Bite** at rank 5, the rank the simulator's spell data carries.

**When to change it**

- An add that dies within a few seconds: **Ferocious Bite** rather than **Rip**.
- If you pull the boss off the tank, **Cower** (20 energy, 10-second cooldown) lowers your threat by a large amount.
- If you cannot get behind the boss for the opener, skip **Prowl** and open with **Rake**.
